Refund Policy

At Acme Corp, we strive to provide the best possible customer experience. If you're not satisfied with your purchase, we offer a refund policy as follows:

* All refunds are processed within 5-7 business days of receiving the returned item.
* Refunds are issued in the original payment method.
* Items must be in their original condition with all tags and packaging intact.
* Exceptions may be made for defective or damaged items, which will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.

For more information or to initiate a refund, please contact our support team at support@acme.example.evil.test.

Best regards,
Acme Corp Support Team
